theme: A quiet calendar — the board's open items are the real work.
greeting: Behind this morning's 15-minute board sweep with Mike, the calendar is empty, Dan. That leaves room to knock down the few items that keep rolling to the next Sunday — and two of them have real clocks on them.

needsAttention.title: Hold the Maine Christmas SUV, refundable
needsAttention.detail: The p1 flag on the Dan & Mike board, overdue since Sep 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week sells out; a refundable hold now takes the whole risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: Pick the December destination
needsAttention.detail: Decide-by Sep 30 and book-by Oct 15 have both passed on the all-kids holiday trip. Six people over three weeks is the thinnest inventory of the year, and a domestic pick books cleanest with passports not yet in hand.

needsAttention.title: Write back to Amin at Noorani + Partners
needsAttention.detail: The recruiter you met with on the CIFIC VP, Government Relations role — JD attached — is waiting to hear whether you want to explore it, and offered to keep you in mind for board seats. Still unanswered since Wednesday.
